item.title: Delhi chokes as AQI hits 459, air quality plunges into ‘severe’ category
item.description: NEW DELHI: Delhi battled toxic air on Sunday as pollution levels worsened sharply, pushing the Air Quality Index (AQI) into the ‘severe’ category.
